login.discordSubtitle: The main entrance. {{product}} only asks for your Discord identity — no email, no servers, no messages.
login.discordSubtitle_PremadeLab: Discord will also ask you to allow direct messages: that is how {{product}} sends you the summary of your evening, the next day. “Create commands” comes with that permission, but {{product}} adds none. No email, no access to your servers.
login.discordHint: You will leave the site while you authorise access on discord.com.

errors.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This screen requires a permission your role does not carry.
errors.discordAborted: Discord sign-in did not complete: you came back without an open session. If you declined the authorisation on discord.com, try again and accept it.
